title: Ulyana and the Detention
author: Casper Whitlock
blurb: Wendell Okonkwo, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
